# Caption notes (generated by scripts/make_paper_figures.py)

## Fig. 1 (system overview)

Top view (body frame, x forward, y left; z up, E3 z offset not shown) of line6, line7 and line8, drawn from quadsim.assembly.assemble with module pitch 0.116 m and rotor radius 0.023 m (module_props.json). Each module is a square frame with 4 rotors at (+-0.028, +-0.028) m from its centre; x_max module is the payload host. Mass M = N x 0.0381 kg (CAD module mass, module_props.json).

## Fig. 2 (classical, confirmatory)

Confirmatory seeds (seed offset 900000, 100 episodes/cell). Percentages: gap of estim-yawlim relative to informed-offset-yawlim,
(inf$-$est)/inf from the plotted means ($\approx$0%: below 0.5%). Dashed: B1-QP-yawlim without payload (same seeds). Error bars: 95% bootstrap CI over episodes. POS = POS_STEP.

## Fig. 3 (RL probe, validation)

Validation seeds (seed offset 100, 100 episodes/cell); exploratory. Circle = RL training seed 7, square = RL training seed 8; label = seed 7/seed 8.
Bars: classical controllers evaluated on the same validation episodes. Error bars: none (the RL/validation JSON files store only per-cell means, no per-episode scores or CI). Not comparable with Fig. 2 (different seed group). Panel (a) tasks: POS_STEP, T2, ATT_STEP.
